source: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.7576524 - 3DPC of a gypsum slope in Finestrat, Alicante (Spain)

_excluded_Intensity.note: EXCLUDED from the agreement claim. PDAL scales E57 intensity by 65535/(intensityMaximum - intensityMinimum) without subtracting the minimum, so its uint16 values do not round-trip the declared limits. The transform is not pinned by the E57 standard, so an agreement tolerance here would measure PDAL's scaling choice rather than either reader's decode.

quantisedSumsNote: Sum of floor(value * 1e6 + 0.5) over all 1788994 points, as exact integers. Order independent and lossless, so it catches ANY single point differing by 1e-6 or more. The mean alone does not: at this point count a single value would have to be wrong by about 1.79 m before it moved the mean past the registered 1e-6 budget. ROUNDING MUST MATCH ON BOTH SIDES: the reference uses floor(x+0.5) because that is what JavaScript's Math.round does; Python's round() is round-half-to-even and disagrees on ties, which showed up as a spurious 208-unit gap before it was matched. PDAL is streamed at precision 17 so text rounding cannot move a value across a quantum boundary. Colour sums are in PDAL's uint16 space; multiply the 8-bit sum by 257.
